reader.requirement: At COBOL-85 each SORT key data-name (qualifiable) must be described in a record of the SD file-name-1 (in any one of its records, the same character positions being the key in all), must not be a group containing a variable occurrence item, must not have or be subordinate to an OCCURS clause, and, when the SD has variable length records (Format 2, or Format 3 which this implementation makes variable), must lie within the first x positions, x the file's minimum record size.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.RecordContainsRangeBindsRecordSize (from 2002) sets BoundsEnforced; at --std 85 a Format 3 SD's minimum record size (item f's x) is the smallest record description, not integer-4

reader.edition-search: Grep of SortBinder.cs and SortKeyAdmission.cs for Edition/DialectLevel/CobolVersion: ctx.Edition is used only as the diagnostic sink; ScreenDataNameShape is called without admitsSubscript2002 so edition.SubscriptedClauseOperands is not reached; the one edition switch on the path is the Format 3 BoundsEnforced flag read through FileModel.RecordSizeRange.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: SD RECORD CONTAINS 5 TO 30 over records of 10 and 30 with a key at positions 6..10: --std 85 accepts and sorts (x = 10, the smallest record description, §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR14); --std 2023 refuses COBOL0874 (x = stated 5)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb1173_sort_key_second_record exercises item d (key described in the second record only); items a, c, e, f, the refusal half and qualification are not exercised by it

probes.printed: COBOL1757 for: FD record key FXK not in SA (a); SAG, a group holding an ODO table, and SAR, the whole ODO record (c); SAO with OCCURS, SAQ under OCCURS, SAT the ODO element (e); SAX USAGE INDEX; COBOL0874 for SVK at 11..15 of a VARYING 10..30 SD and S3K at 11..15 of a Format 3 10..30 SD (f); COBOL2024 for subscripted SAO (1)
probes.expected: each refused under SR4 a, c, e, f (and the data-name format)

qualified keys KEYA OF GRP OF SMB (DESC) and KEYN IN SMB (ASC) described only in the second record, applied to records released through the first; key at 1..5 of a VARYING 5..20 SD (edge of f) accepted
85: records are sized by their descriptions (10 and 30), so x = 10 and the key at 6..10 is legal

reader.notes: An SD with an ODO record and no RECORD clause is fixed under D-FRA, which §1985:II.2.1.4.3 leaves to the implementor, so item f does not reach it. The Format 3 reading of x (smallest record description, not integer-4) rests on GR14's second sentence; a reader taking 'minimum record size specified' as integer-4 would refuse s4f3 at 85. Diagnostics cite the 2023 rule numbers (SR6 a..g).
reader.at-2023: s4bad: the same 10 refusals; s4f3: refused (stated minimum 5)

refuter.evidence: Read SR4 a-f (§1985:XI.4.4.3) with §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR14 and §1985:VI.5.14.3 SR5; SortKeyAdmission.cs#Violation, SortBinder.cs#SortAddFileKeys, FileModel.cs#RecordSizeRange (Format 3 BoundsEnforced arm at 85). Probes at --std 85: s4r2.cob run EXIT 0: group key SAG holding a FIXED OCCURS table (legal: the key's own entry has no OCCURS clause, item e) ASC with DESC REDEFINES-subordinate SAX2 sorted [AACCDD99][ZZBBAA12][ZZBBCC07]; level-66 RENAMES key DESC gave DD99,CC07,AA12; no-RECORD-clause SD with records 10/30 (implied fixed 30) and key at 21..25 described only in the 30-byte record sorted the short record first (spaces) then AAAAA, BBBBB. s4r4.cob compile: VARYING FROM 5 TO 30 over records 10/30 key at 6..10 refused COBOL0874 (x = stated integer-2 = 5, item f); key of another SD and a WORKING-STORAGE key refused COBOL1757 (item a); Format 3 10 TO 30 key 8..12 with records 15/30 accepted (x = 15). s4r6.cob: Format 3 10 TO 30 over records 10/15/30, key at 8..12 refused COBOL0874 (x = 10). s4r3.cob: USAGE INDEX key refused COBOL1757, backed at 85 by §1985:VI.5.14.3 SR5 (SORT KEY is not among the permitted references). s4r5.cob: table SORT refused at 85 (COBOL0870). cite.py: 'OK  §1985:XI.4.4.3 SR4f ... the text is in SR4f'; 'OK  §1985:XI.4.4.3 SR4e ... the text is in SR4e'; 'OK  §1985:VI.5.14.3 SR5  (5.14.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR5'; 'OK  §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR14 ... the text is in GR14'. Reading stated: for a Format 3 SD whose integer-4 disagrees with its smallest record description, 'minimum record size specified' is taken as the smallest description, since GR14 defines integer-4 as that size and makes the descriptions govern; where integer-4 matches the descriptions both readings agree.
